calls.title: Initiate
calls.quote: Initiate is Hub71’s early-stage programme that supports founders at the ideation or pre-MVP stage to turn their ideas into scalable startups. By joining, founders will be connected with experienced venture builders and gain the resources, mentorship, and ecosystem access needed to transform ideas into startups that can scale.

calls.title: MZN x Hub71 Programme
calls.quote: The MZN x Hub71 Programme is a three-month programme powered by Hub71 in partnership with the Khalifa Fund for Enterprise Development, designed to support Emirati founders in transforming innovative ideas into market-ready minimum viable products (MVPs).

calls.title: Hub71 Sandbox Programme
calls.quote: Access a guided track to trial your solution with regulators, validate it in real-world environments, and move towards market deployment.

calls.title: India (Hub71 Immersion Programme)
calls.quote: The Hub71 Immersion Programme is a structured, in-market experience designed to support international startups as they explore and build connections within Abu Dhabi’s global tech ecosystem. Delivered in partnership with the UAE–India CEPA Council, the programme provides founders with direct access to key market stakeholders, including investors, corporates and government entities, enabling startups to assess and accelerate their expansion into the region.

calls.title: Access Programme
calls.quote: Get the support you need to take your business to the next level in Abu Dhabi. Our Access Program offers a comprehensive support package and a route into the UAE capital’s marketplace. The benefits include in-kind and cash incentives and access to our vibrant community of capital and corporate partners, and mentors.

calls.title: ECA Anjal Z x Hub71
calls.quote: The ECA Anjal Z x Hub71 programme supports startups addressing challenges across early childhood development, from pregnancy through age eight, by providing direct access to government partners, pilot opportunities, and Hub71’s broader innovation ecosystem. Founders are supported to embed locally, demonstrate impact, and scale with confidence.

calls.title: Your gateway to SAVI
calls.quote: Hub71 is your startup’s gateway into Abu Dhabi’s SAVI cluster. Smart and autonomous mobility startups joining Hub71 gain direct access to SAVI’s network of partners, regulators and testing environments. This enables founders to validate, deploy and scale solutions across land, air and sea.

calls.title: Hub71+ Life Sciences
calls.quote: Hub71+ Life Sciences is Abu Dhabi’s specialist ecosystem driving innovation across biotechnology, MedTech, and digital health. From precision medicine to biomanufacturing, we bring together founders, researchers, regulators, investors, and corporates to advance next-generation healthcare solutions from Abu Dhabi to the world.

calls.title: Hub71+ Digital Assets
calls.quote: Hub71+ Digital Assets is a dedicated programme to promote Web3 startup growth from the heart of Abu Dhabi. We provide an integrated launchpad that unites builders, regulators, investors, foundations, corporate partners, and enthusiasts around Web3 including blockchain and cryptocurrency startups. No matter where you are in your journey, there’s something for you at Hub71.

calls.title: Hub71+ ClimateTech
calls.quote: Hub71+ ClimateTech is a specialist ecosystem, where sustainability startups leverage technologies to drive decarbonization in supporting a net zero future. The programme offers a comprehensive support package and a route into the UAE capital's marketplace.

calls.title: Hub71+ AI
calls.quote: Hub71+ AI is a specialist ecosystem designed to support startups at the forefront of AI innovation. The ecosystem provides advanced technical resources, access to a robust network of AI researchers, industry practitioners, and strategic partners, and tailored expertise in AI-driven product development and scalability. With a focus on fostering collaboration and accelerating AI integration across sectors, Hub71+ AI empowers startups to develop and deploy sophisticated AI solutions, enabling founders to achieve operational efficiency, drive industry disruption, and deliver sustainable impact.

calls.quote: Company building program with flexible incentives
